required_inputs.artifact-dir: Exact ZIP extraction root containing qa-reports/ and qa-run/, without locally added files.
required_inputs.run-metadata: Original GitHub REST run object (id, head_sha, repository.full_name, event, run_attempt, status).
required_inputs.artifact-metadata: Original GitHub REST artifacts object containing artifacts array and digest/workflow_run fields.
required_inputs.job-metadata: Original GitHub REST jobs object including ordered gate/secret-scan steps.
required_inputs.zip: Exact GitHub artifact ZIP matching its API digest.
required_inputs.output: A new report path; existing output is refused.

automatic_checks: GitHub fork/run/head/dispatch/attempt identity and exact ZIP digest; every decoded ZIP file byte size/hash matches raw extraction.
Artifact frozen plan, local frozen harness file identities and exact-main pins; two fixed ordered slots with all partial raw files retained.
Completed native jobs/trials; parent-group/container cleanup status; exact per-profile mount allowlist without reading original CI bind paths.
Recompute both source snapshot inventory digests against the 1232-file frozen corpus; reject unexpected additions/symlinks and baseline zg/MCP/home/embedding-environment presence.
Compare recorded live OpenCode version/binary with both profiles and host mock binary; compare treatment Rust identity with frozen candidate.
Recompute root plus recursive child session usage from DB rows; verify graph, complete assistant messages, provider/model and exact exported assistant/tool IDs.
Verify native terminal stream/DB/ATIF/root-export final agreement and unchanged root instruction; final answer is only hashed, not emitted or graded.
Index all root/child tool records including terminal failures by IDs/status/raw JSON reference and argument/output hashes.
Check ready treatment remote setup, correct workspace, frozen package/model/endpoint and no restored seed.
manual_checks_required_before_protocol_v: Inspect all root AND child tool inputs/outputs for no-web/source-only compliance, not only heuristic flags.

Check solver-visible prompt/source/tool data for evaluator, reference, experiment plan or historical answer exposure. Host trial configuration manifest paths are expected host-only and must not be falsely labeled leakage.

For actual zg solver calls inspect successful MCP/native response semantics, actual /workspace roots, returned source paths and relevance to q001; completed tool status and setup/preflight alone do not prove retrieval success.
Audit native command/config and job gate receipts, measured wall/usage/audit/export overhead and separate grant/index/MCP/cold timings.
Check each slot failure/skip/cleanup record and all retained directories; CI success never substitutes for protocol validity or complete captured usage.
guardrails: No dispatch, polling, model/provider calls, secret-value inspection, repository edits or grading.
Script always leaves protocol_valid and retrieval-success verdict null pending manual evidence review; no efficiency/quality conclusion.
Unknown/missing required metadata or identity fails closed. Per-arm failures remain reported and raw inventory retained.
Live HTTP bodies are not retained; pinned native local-mock request contract cannot prove opaque provider weights or every real wire parameter.
Source invariance is before/after controller hashing, not independent retained post-run source bytes or an OS-enforced read-only mount.
Persisted-session accounting excludes unpersisted background/provider requests and embedding usage; zero custom-provider cost remains unknown.
